item.title: “Apparently I’m Vanilla”: Woman’s Life Turns Upside Down After Accidentally Uncovering Husband’s Affair
item.description: Extramarital affairs are frowned upon and can leave a trail of destruction, yet they remain quite common. Whether someone considers emotional or physical intimacy as cheating, the betrayal can hurt just the same. A woman, about eight weeks pregnant, shared her story of betrayal online, revealing how she discovered her husband’s secret affair through messages on his phone. What made the situation even worse was finding out that the other woman was someone from her past.

item.title: 45 People Confess Which Celebrities They Used To Like But Now Wholeheartedly Hate
item.description: Celebrities can be entertaining, inspiring, and even feel like role models. But putting them on a pedestal rarely ends well. Time and time again, famous people end up reminding us that they’re just as flawed as anyone else, sometimes in ways that are hard to ignore. So when one Redditor asked people which celebrities they stopped supporting after learning what they were really like, users had plenty of answers, naming stars who completely lost their respect.

item.title: 49 Brutally Honest Social Media Posts About Politics That Might Make You Want To Move To Another Planet (New Pics)
item.description: It’s hard to look at the state of the world right now and stay positive. Even if you consider yourself to be an optimist, it might feel like your country’s leaders are doing everything they can to dim your spirit. But if you want to be brutally honest about what’s going on at the moment, here’s a list of political tweets that might make you want to move to another planet.

item.title: 42 Of The Weirdest Subreddits That Are For Some Reason Very Popular
item.description: You think you know enough about Reddit as a platform until you see some of the weirdest subreddits we’ve compiled on this list. Some of them are funny, while others are just plain weird. It just goes to show how massively vast the internet is in this day and age, and how quirky some people can get. Scroll through to see if any of these ring a bell for you.

item.title: 41 Examples Of People Operating At 1% Brain Capacity
item.description: Everyone slips up now and then, but some mistakes are so spectacular they practically deserve their own trophy. We’ve rounded up some truly head-scratching moments people shared online. Scroll carefully, you might feel a facepalm coming on.

item.title: 53 Times A Mystery Or An Unexplained Phenomenon Made People Question Reality
item.description: "Freaks me out but also pretty cool," one person wrote about the phenomenon of déjà vu. This and more mysteries of the world make people scratch their heads daily. For some, it's their personal experiences of things like an ocular migraine or something supernatural. To others, it's mysteries like the placebo effect or the story of the Somerton Man. Here's a collection of some bizarre things that keep people up at night, and not in a good way.

item.title: 47 Hilarious Pics Of Pets Living Rent-Free And Performing Like Ungrateful Hooligans
item.description: They live rent-free with their own butlers, drivers, chefs, shoppers, and stylists. They laze around, eat, sleep, play, poop and repeat with not a care in the world. Yet you'll never hear a "thank you" from them, nor a "sorry" when they cause chaos and destruction. Pet owners have been "shaming" their naughty furkids, and the pics are comedy gold.

item.title: 59 Anti-Motivational Affirmations That Are Strangely Relatable
item.description: Contrary to what some from the self-help industry suggest, experiencing negative emotions like anger, sadness, fear, and jealousy is a perfectly normal and even essential part of being human. So to reclaim this right, writer, creator, and self-described hot mess Dave Tarnowski launched a project called Disappointing Affirmations, where he shares phrases that are less about inspiration and more about honesty. item.title: 51 Eerie, Odd And Thought-Provoking Stories About People Experiencing Unexplained Things
item.description: Reality should be fairly stable... But every now and then, the universe seems to play a few tricks on us. We see things or people that surely should not be there, or experience moments that make absolutely no sense at all. People have been sharing the times the Mandela Effect left them confused, and these posts are the best.

item.title: “Green Hairy Tongue!”: These 41 Medical Images That Should Be Viewed With Caution (New Pics)
item.description: The medical world is full of images that can make many people squirm. But others can’t seem to look away.
